title: Ark of the Covenant claimed kept at Aksum
summary: Graham Hancock tells of Ark of the Covenant claimed kept at Aksum, about c. 1983-1990s at Chapel beside Church of St Mary of Zion, Aksum, Tigray, Ethiopia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Chapel beside Church of St Mary of Zion, Aksum, Tigray, Ethiopia

tellings.quote: we have the we have the Ark of the Covenant here

plain: An author named Graham Hancock says that while researching his book The Sign and the Seal, from the 1980s into the 1990s, he was told in the Ethiopian town of Aksum that the Ark of the Covenant, the sacred chest of the Bible, was kept there in a chapel beside the Church of St Mary of Zion. He recalls being told plainly, "we have the Ark of the Covenant here," which, if true, would place one of history's most famous lost objects in Ethiopia.
